2._section_summary: This discussion section summarizes a single study that investigated how instructions to 'be creative' or 'come up with a lot of ideas' influenced responses on divergent thinking tasks. The study found that 'be creative' instructions boosted subjective creativity ratings but reduced response quantity, while 'standard instructions' increased quantity but reduced creative quality. Furthermore, an interaction was observed where fluid intelligence specifically enhanced creative quality when participants were asked to be creative.
